content_of_post_to_comment: Maybe everyone suddenly wanting out of corporate isn’t a sign that people have become lazy or less resilient. Maybe they’ve simply stopped believing the deal is worth it. I love writing about this topic, so always love to hear everyone else’s thoughts on it.
comment: The interesting shift may be that people aren't rejecting work itself, but a specific exchange: sacrificing autonomy today for promised security tomorrow. The question is whether that promise ever matched reality.
